notices.short_title: DSNY PROPOSED AMENDMENT OF RULES RELATING TO THE IMPLEMENTATION OF THE EIGHTH AND NINTH COMMERCIAL WASTE ZONES AND INFREQUENT WASTE GENERATORS
notices.plain: The Department of Sanitation will hold a public hearing on March 5, 2026, on proposed changes to its rules for implementing the eighth and ninth commercial waste zones and infrequent waste generators.

notices.short_title: GENUINE REPLACEMENT PARTS FOR GENERAL MOTORS CARS
notices.plain: The Department of Citywide Administrative Services awarded Frank's Truck Center a contract worth $1.125 million for genuine replacement parts for General Motors cars, chosen through competitive sealed bids in which the lowest qualified bid wins.

notices.short_title: Brand Specific OEM Machine Tools for DEP
notices.plain: The Department of Citywide Administrative Services awarded Sid Tool Co Inc a $3,185,908 contract, chosen through competitive sealed bids, for brand-specific original equipment manufacturer machine tools for the Department of Environmental Protection.

notices.short_title: Bid 2600011 - NYC Condom Availability Program - DOHMH
notices.plain: The Department of Citywide Administrative Services awarded Global Protection Corp a $6.1 million contract for goods for the New York City Condom Availability Program, run by the Department of Health and Mental Hygiene, after competitive sealed bidding in which the lowest qualified bid wins.
The Department of Citywide Administrative Services awarded Diehl & Sons Inc a $6.6 million contract for vans, battery electric vehicles and diesel vehicles, chosen through competitive sealed bids.
The Department of Correction awarded Xerox Corporation a $353,612 contract for a copier and printer, bought through a contract another government already holds.

notices.agency_name: Dept. of Social Svcs/Human Resources Administration
notices.short_title: IT Consulting services IT Devep & Manag & CAPS Projects
notices.plain: The Human Resources Administration awarded ManpowerGroup Public Sector, Inc. a $1.6 million contract for IT consulting services on IT development and management and CAPS projects, through an intergovernmental purchase.

notices.vendor_name: New York State Industries for the Disabled Inc
notices.plain: The Department of Finance awarded New York State Industries for the Disabled Inc a $74,999 contract for scanning land record books in fiscal year 2026, using a required method that directs the city to use this source.
The Department of Health and Mental Hygiene awarded Mind4, Inc a $10 million contract for creative development of public education, chosen from competing proposals.

notices.short_title: SMD_Services_Preventative Maintenance on Boilers within Various Developments, Borough Focus (Re-Bid of 517971,1)
notices.plain: The New York City Housing Authority is seeking bids from contractors for preventive maintenance on boilers at various developments, with responses due Feb. 17, 2026, and the lowest qualified bid to win.

notices.short_title: CNYG-4622M Citywide Indoor Pool Filter Plant Reconstruction
notices.plain: The Department of Parks and Recreation is seeking bids through Competitive Sealed Bids, where the lowest qualified bid wins, for construction work reconstructing filter plants at citywide indoor pools, with responses due Feb. 27, 2026.

notices.short_title: Sheetrock and Tile Installation at Bronx DA Office -198 Bldg
notices.plain: The Bronx County District Attorney's Office has a notice on sheetrock and tile installation work at its 198 building, with an event date of Feb. 10, 2026, and no contract amount or vendor is given.

notices.short_title: WI-298CM Construction Management Services for the Conversion of SHARON to Deammonification Process at Wards Island Wastewater Resource Recovery Facility.
notices.plain: The Department of Environmental Protection published a notice inviting public comment on a contract for construction management services for converting a process called SHARON to deammonification at the Wards Island Wastewater Resource Recovery Facility.
The Department of Sanitation has published a notice about a contract for HVAC air filters.

notices.short_title: Correction: City Planning Commission Public Hearing
notices.plain: The City Planning Commission has issued a correction to its public hearing notice, with the hearing scheduled for Feb. 18, 2026.
